name: WF-310 — Final CRM Closeout → Portfolio Performance Record & Underwriting Feedback

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const deal=input.deal??input; const closeoutStatus=String(deal.status??deal.closeout_status??'').toLowerCase(); const dealId=deal.deal_id??deal.id; const leadId=deal.lead_id; const propertyId=deal.property_id; const closeId=deal.close_id; const grossProfit=Number(deal.gross_profit??0); const closingCosts=Number(deal.closing_costs??deal.costs??0); const netProfit=Number(deal.net_profit??(grossProfit-closingCosts)); const closeDate=deal.close_date??deal.actual_closing_date; const exitStrategy=deal.exit_strategy??'assignment'; const blockers=Array.isArray(deal.blockers)?deal.blockers:[]; const identityReady=Boolean(dealId&&leadId&&propertyId&&closeId); const inputsValid=[grossProfit,closingCosts,netProfit].every(Number.isFinite); const ready=closeoutStatus==='closeout_ready'||closeoutStatus==='negative_profit_review'; const margin=grossProfit!==0?netProfit/grossProfit:null; const performanceSignal=netProfit>0?'positive':netProfit===0?'breakeven':'negative'; const status=!ready||blockers.length?'blocked':!identityReady||!closeDate?'incomplete':!inputsValid?'invalid_profit_inputs':'performance_record_ready'; const portfolioPerformance={deal_id:dealId,close_id:closeId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,close_date:closeDate,deal_type:deal.deal_type??'wholesale',exit_strategy:grossProfit>=0?exitStrategy:'review',gross_profit:grossProfit,closing_costs:closingCosts,net_profit:netProfit,profit_margin:margin,performance_signal:performanceSignal}; const underwritingFeedback={signal:performanceSignal,net_profit:netProfit,profit_margin:margin,asset_type:deal.asset_type??deal.property_type??'unknown',ma_rule:'secondary_reference_only',calibration_ready:status==='performance_record_ready'}; return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-310',workflow_name:'Final CRM Closeout → Portfolio Performance Record & Underwriting Feedback',status,identity_ready:identityReady,profit_inputs_valid:inputsValid,performance_signal:performanceSignal,profit_margin:margin,portfolio_performance:portfolioPerformance,underwriting_feedback:underwritingFeedback,crm_activity:{activity_type:'portfolio_performance_record',deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,close_id:closeId,status,portfolio_performance:portfolioPerformance,underwriting_feedback:underwritingFeedback},next_workflow:status==='performance_record_ready'?'WF-311':status==='blocked'?'WF-126':'WF-309'}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { workflow_id: $json.workflow_id, status: $json.status, next_workflow: $json.next_workflow, portfolio_performance: $json.portfolio_performance, underwriting_feedback: $json.underwriting_feedback, crm_persisted: true } }}
